draft.text: You came in because you have sharp pain on the right side of your abdomen, just below your ribs, that radiates to your lower abdomen and groin.
The pain is severe when it happens and affects your daily activities.
You also have nausea, a burning feeling when you urinate, and sometimes dark-colored urine.
We did not do any tests or measurements during this visit.
You are likely having an episode of right-sided abdominal pain, which may be related to a kidney stone.
You have a history of kidney stones, but this one is taking longer to pass.
You will continue taking oxycodone as needed for pain, and you can alternate with Tylenol if needed.
